{"notes": "Visit 2 (left 2:45). Still haven't seen who physically placed dominoes, so execution ratings stay provisional.

Hana: Keeps directing clearly. At 2:15 told Omar not to trace the bottom line, parked him at the nose for the join check, and said she's carrying on with the top herself. Good role clarity, but the top line is the long, unfinished part and she's doing it solo; she hasn't yet taken up Jack's offer (pending). Watch whether she delegates or becomes the bottleneck. Leadership positive; collaboration good.

Jack: Showed initiative and good judgment at 2:30. Spotted that the bottom was nearly done while the top lagged, offered to take over the top from where Hana is, and explicitly waited for her word to avoid doubling up. Proactive and self-corrected his earlier nose overlap with Omar. Strong collaboration/ownership signal. Need to see whether he actually builds.

Omar: Responsive, accepts direction, stays off the lines, will wait at the nose. Chose to check a doubled bit in the middle of the body, self-directed but reasonable. Reliable but passive; little output so far. Verify the body issue and whether he's idle while the top is behind.

Sofia: Per Hana and Jack, she built the bottom line, now nearly at the nose. That is real impact, secondhand but consistent from two people. I still haven't seen her work or heard from her. Ask her privately and watch her hands. Don't penalize her for being quiet.

Table: Top line still has a gap to close toward the nose; the chain is continuous from START with no pale dominoes. Next: see if Jack is on the top, and whether the join works."}
